newsitem.title: USA: Signet to sell mortgage production business.
newsitem.headline: Signet to sell mortgage production business.

text.p: Signet Banking Corp said on Monday that its subsidiary, Signet Mortgage Corp, has agreed to sell its retail first mortgage loan production offices to AccuBanc Mortgage Corp, a national mortgage banking operation headquartered in Dallas.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the company said it had agreed to sell at a premium.

The deal includes 24 mortgage production offices in seven states, primarily in the Southeast and Middle Atlantic areas, and includes a substantial portion of Signet's centralized processing assets, the company said.
Signet said that it would continue to participate actively in the mortgage banking business and that the transaction reflects its endeavors at refining its business strategies.
